answer: A Weekly community check-in streak over one year verified by attendance records forces the applicant to show up again and again: every week the applicant signs in, the attendance records go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a Sybil farm must sustain every fake identity for months instead of minting them in an afternoon. A lone ridge proves nothing about staying power; only the full streak counts. A onyx and a dune may look alike, but only the identity with an unbroken record is honoured.
